<a id="music_freq_lo"></a>
### [`music_freq_lo`](../../../src/music_workspace.asm#L6) `$0C8C-$0C8E`

*variable*

Arrays of 3 bytes are indexed by the voice X (0-2 = SID voice 1-3). The file holds $00/$ff runs and stray values here, not a driver state. The stray values differ from version I.
Note frequency low byte, voice x (target of the slide)
